new_refinements_adopted: Pin mkosi and backend version/commit/config digest in every simulator receipt.
Treat vmspawn and QEMU as explicit peer VM backends, never silent fallbacks.
Separate VM EPHEMERAL from PERSISTENT_COPY because ephemeral clean-state replay can mask persistence/update/rollback defects.
Record KVM/VSOCK/TPM/EFI-NVRAM capability as OBSERVED_AVAILABLE|OBSERVED_UNAVAILABLE|UNKNOWN and fail closed rather than changing host security configuration automatically.
Use a typed TwinBackendProfile so nspawn/vmspawn/qemu results cannot collapse into one ambiguous simulator PASS.
Desktop/media/device fidelity remains an upper layer above boot backend fidelity; VM boot does not imply Wayland/PipeWire/portal/device proof.
refinement_to_prior_delta: The prior abstract Tier-B label QEMU/KVM is retained as a proof-obligation class, not a single implementation. Concrete Tier-B implementation should be backend-profile driven with VMSPAWN_VM and QEMU_VM peers. This is a refinement, not a contradiction.
combined_hypothesis: A typed multi-backend simulated twin using a cheap NSPAWN_FAST lane plus explicit VM backends will find more target-transfer defects per resource unit than either a container-only or opaque single-VM harness, provided results retain exact backend/fidelity provenance.
combined_counterhypothesis: The backend matrix may create maintenance cost without unique defect discovery beyond one well-configured VM plus synthetic faults.
next_discriminator: Measure identical bounded scenarios across NSPAWN_FAST, VMSPAWN_VM and QEMU_VM: unique defect yield, deterministic replay, cold-start latency, steady RSS, disk IO, setup failure rate and configuration surface. Retire any backend whose marginal information gain does not justify cost.
